proposal: (1) ST valve casings designed for the HRSG outlet conditions; (2) new IF-45 / IF-46 at the inlet of the IEC spray control stations; (3) IF-03 at the skid inlet, 3.0-6.0 barg; (4) tap-off rated >= 170 kA; (5) IF-001 Rev A with the agreed data.
question: The EPC tie-in register (engine tie_in_register, draft) checks every terminal point against the nine PER-003 Rev A cases and against its upstream point. Please confirm or correct: (1) IF-06 (200 bar(a) / 605 degC), IF-10 (48 bar(a) / 605 degC) and IF-12 (8 bar(a)) are below the design of the HRSG outlets feeding them (IF-05 210 bar(a) / 610 degC, IF-09 50 bar(a) / 610 degC, IF-11 10 bar(a)); the EPC piping between them is designed for the HRSG side. State the ST valve casing design conditions, or the safety valve set points that protect the ST side. (2) HMB streams 29 and 30 (HP and reheat attemperation spray water from the EPC BFP discharge/interstage to the HRSG) cross the scope boundary but have no terminal point in IF-001 Rev 0. (3) PER-003 stream 28 (water injection) is at 60 bar(a), IF-03 is 4 in CL150 / 16 barg: confirm IF-03 is at the skid inlet upstream of IEC injection pumps, the pressure required there, and that the pump power is in the IEC auxiliaries. (4) IF-36: the EPC estimates 169 kA prospective short-circuit current at the GT generator bus (96 kA from the system via the GSU + 73 kA from the generator); state the IPB tap-off rating. (5) Confirm the operating envelopes, scope breaks, isolation, protection and dates of the attached draft (dates per the EPC commissioning sequence DEC-EPCE-0004) and re-issue IF-001.
response: (1) The IF-001 Rev 0 values at IF-06/IF-10/IF-12 were the ST rated inlet conditions (IEC 60045-1). Valve casing design: main stop valve 215 bar(a) / 610 degC, IP stop/control valves 52 bar(a) / 610 degC, LP admission valve 10 bar(a) / 330 degC; the HRSG safety valves (HP SH <= 196 bar(a), HRH <= 48 bar(a), LP SH 8.0 bar(a)) protect both sides. (2) Accepted: IF-45 (HP spray, 3 in CL2500) and IF-46 (reheat spray, 2 in CL600) at the inlet of the IEC spray control stations. (3) Confirmed: IF-03 is the water injection skid inlet, 3.0-6.0 barg; stream 28 in PER-003 is the skid discharge; the injection pumps are in the IEC GT auxiliaries. (4) IPB tap-off rated 200 kA symmetrical / 550 kA peak. (5) Draft data confirmed with the corrections above; IEC-ALP-IF-001 Rev A issued.
